search_text: published ZDI-25-755 ZDI-CAN-25672 (Pwn2Own) QNAP QHora-322 qsyslog-cli username Format String Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2025-07-31 7.5 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['QNAP'] ['QHora-322'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP QHora-322 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the username parameter provided to the qsyslog-cli executable. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it as a format specifier. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root. QNAP has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://www.qnap.com/en-us/security-advisories ['2024-12-02 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2025-07-31 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2025-07-31 - Advisory Updated'] Chris Anastasio @mufinnnnnnn & Fabius Watson https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-25-755/
title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP QHora-322 qsyslog-cli username Format String Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the username parameter provided to the qsyslog-cli executable. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it as a format specifier. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root.
